sloka: दृष्ट्वा श्रेयस्करीं बुद्धिं धनाध्यक्षो भविष्यति ।नाम तस्याकरोत्प्रीतः सार्धं देवर्षिभिस्तदा ।। ७.३.७ ॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śreyaskarīṁ buddhiṁ dhanādhyakṣo bhaviṣyati ।nāma tasyākarotprītaḥ sārdhaṁ devarṣibhistadā ।। 7.3.7 ॥

translations.english: Having perceived his auspicious intention to become the lord of wealth, the pleased grandfather (Brahma), together with the divine sages, then gave him a name.
